schema:name: Coffee Drying, Bahia, Brazil
schema:description: This image depicts the patio coffee drying process, with a worker turning the drying beans with a rake in the background. Hacienda La Minita, Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, maintains relationships with specialty coffee producers, millers, and exporters around the world. In Bahia, Brazil, Hacienda La Minita worked with a local mill to develop its fully washed “La Minita Prep,” refining processing and quality requirements for the coffee.
